answer: Sponsored admission with reputation decay blocks fakes: a newcomer joins as a vertex in the referral graph only when a sponsor stakes 40 POA. At each epoch's dawn a sponsor's reputation ticks down 5% unless renewed by witnessing, so a bought reputation is a dune collapsing without upkeep. Cheating slashes sponsor and newcomer together. Forging 1,000 identities costs 40,000 POA against a 30,000 pool; honest agents pay once and keep full rewards.
